subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Azure Ronin, the young adult male swordsman in <Picture 1>, with short black hair with subtle blue streaks, amber eyes, a lean athletic build, a dark navy split-tail combat coat, black tactical armor, and metallic forearm armor. He carries one blue plasma katana and one physical scabbard at his left waist.
<Subject 2> is Crimson Aegis, the young adult female fighter in <Picture 2>, with a silver-white high ponytail, crimson eyes, an athletic build, a fitted black combat bodysuit, and dark crimson armor. She wears two red-black mechanical gauntlets, one attached to each hand and forearm, each bearing one short crimson energy blade aligned along the outer forearm.
<Subject 3> is the abandoned underground metro tunnel in <Picture 3>, with wet rails, gravel, shallow puddles, concrete walls, overhead pipes, dim red emergency lights, and drifting steam. The pictures provide character and environment references rather than fixed shot compositions.

summary:
[reference generation] A 15-second, 16:9 cinematic action sequence featuring <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> in <Subject 3>. Seven shots show her rapid charge, his slow descent into a draw stance, the initial blade withdrawal in close-up, and an instantaneous relocation behind her with a brief translucent blue afterimage. His single draw-slash coincides with the teleport; her punch misses. The final three shots show his controlled sheathing in close-up, a delayed cut opening across the tunnel wall, and finally an implied fatal strike followed by her defocused collapse to the ground. Preserve this exact order: sheathing, wall fracture, defocused collapse.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - retain his male identity, facial features, hair, clothing, armor, single katana, and physical scabbard. The afterimage is a temporary optical effect, not another physical character. He draws once, slashes once, and sheathes once.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 4], [Shot 7]): fully_preserved - retain her female identity, facial features, ponytail, clothing, armor, and two attached mechanical gauntlets. Their energy blades are active during the attack and extinguish during her final loss of strength; the physical gauntlets remain attached.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5], [Shot 6], [Shot 7]): partially_preserved - retain the tunnel layout, rails, lighting, moisture, and materials. Add only a localized delayed cut and falling dust to one concrete wall section in [Shot 6]. Close-ups show defocused portions of the environment.

detailed_description:
Cinematic realistic 3D with natural human proportions, detailed wet materials, restrained blue-red lighting, and readable silhouettes. Seven shots contrast fast aggression, slow preparation, sudden release, and a quiet delayed aftermath; no subtitles, visible text, blood, or wounds.

[Shot 1] A low frontal medium shot centers <Subject 2>, her silver-white ponytail streaming behind her black-and-crimson armor. The camera tracks backward ahead of her, facing her as she charges through <Subject 3>. Her boots scatter puddle water. Her right fist is drawn back for a punch; her left arm balances her stride. Both attached gauntlets glow with tightly contained crimson energy, their short blades aligned outside her forearms. Heavy footsteps, splashes, and electrical crackling dominate. <Subject 1> is outside the frame.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, hard cut to a three-quarter medium shot of <Subject 1> alone, framed from head to knees. His black-and-blue hair, amber eyes, and navy coat are clearly visible against the damp tunnel. Starting nearly upright with planted feet, he slowly bends his knees and lowers into a controlled half-crouch. His right hand grips the hilt; his left stabilizes the scabbard at his left hip. The blade remains fully sheathed. The camera gently pushes closer. Faint approaching crimson light touches his face. As he settles, <Subject 1> (S1) says in a quiet, low, controlled male voice, <d>[Chinese] 结束了。</d> He closes his mouth. The distant charge softens beneath his voice.

[Shot 3] At 00:04.500, hard cut to one steady extreme close-up of <Subject 1>'s hands, hilt, and scabbard mouth. His left hand braces the scabbard while his right slowly pulls the hilt outward. Only a short section of blade emerges, casting a thin blue reflection across damp metal. Subtle metal friction and a plasma hum accompany this initial withdrawal. Most of the blade remains inside when the shot ends.

[Shot 4] At 00:06.000, hard cut to a locked side-on two-character medium-wide shot. <Subject 2> is screen-left, charging right; <Subject 1> is screen-right, facing left in his half-crouch, blade partly withdrawn. Briefly establish both positions. As she punches right, he completes one draw and one slash: his opaque body disappears from the right-hand starting point and immediately appears screen-left, behind her, facing left with the fully drawn katana held low. A faint translucent blue silhouette lingers only at his starting point, then rapidly dissolves; it has blurred edges, no readable face, and no independent movement. One thin blue blade streak fades between the positions. Her punch passes into empty space; their weapons never touch. His arrival is already motionless, without running or braking. One sharp cutting sound gives way to quiet. Keep one opaque male body, the camera and background fixed, and both fighters visible without a full-frame flash. Hold these separated poses until the cut at 00:08.000. <Subject 2> remains standing.

[Shot 5] At 00:08.000, hard cut to a steady close-up of <Subject 1>'s hands, katana, and scabbard at his left hip. He stands behind his opponent, facing away from her; she is outside the frame. His right hand holds the fully drawn sword while his left stabilizes the scabbard mouth. He calmly raises and aligns the blade, guides its tip into the opening, then slides it inward in one smooth, controlled motion. The exposed blade progressively disappears inside the physical scabbard while retaining its shape and length. Blue reflections diminish across the wet metal. A clean sliding sound ends with one distinct metallic click as the guard seats against the scabbard mouth. Complete the sheathing before the next cut; the sword stays sheathed afterward.

[Shot 6] At 00:11.000, hard cut to a steady medium close-up of the concrete tunnel wall beside the rail bed, beyond the place where <Subject 2> stood during the strike. Neither fighter is in frame. A thin horizontal blue seam appears across a limited section of wet concrete. The seam opens into a narrow, clearly visible physical cut; its edges separate slightly and a small curtain of concrete dust falls. The blue glow fades, leaving the split visible. This is the delayed consequence of the single earlier slash, without another attack or projectile. A dry concrete crack and falling grit punctuate the silence. The wall remains standing; no explosion or tunnel collapse.

[Shot 7] At 00:12.500, hard cut to <Subject 2> alone in a three-quarter medium-full shot, facing screen-right beside the wet rails. Her right fist lowers after the missed punch. A faint horizontal blue glint briefly crosses the armor at her waist, marking the delayed effect of the earlier single slash rather than a new attack. Her gauntlet energy flickers out.

As she loses strength, rack focus away from her onto a rain bead on a foreground hanging cable. Her entire figure becomes a soft, unreadable background silhouette before she collapses. The blurred silhouette drops out of its standing position onto the wet track bed, accompanied by one heavy armored impact.

Keep the figure visually whole; no visible bodily separation, exposed injury, or blood, including within the blur. Hold focus on the cable and falling water, with her motionless fallen silhouette indistinct in the background through 00:15.000. Both physical gauntlets remain attached. <Subject 1> is outside the frame. No additional attack, dialogue, or cut follows.

overall_soundscape:
Reverberant underground room tone, sparse dripping water, armored footfalls, splashes, and restrained gauntlet electricity. Close metal friction and a soft plasma hum accompany the partial draw. A single sharp cutting transient marks the teleport, followed by subdued ambience. The aftermath is sequential: smooth sheathing and one metallic click, then a dry wall fracture with falling grit, then electrical shutdown and one heavy armored body impact against the wet track bed. No weapon-clash sound or additional speech.

non_diegetic_music:
A restrained sustained low bass tone under the charge, reduced beneath the spoken line. A faint rising tension tone accompanies the blade close-up. Cut the score at the teleport. Keep the sheathing, wall fracture, and defocused collapse free of music so their individual sounds remain clear. End on natural tunnel ambience.
